AgiBot World Challenge 2026 - Datasets
	

Dear participants,
We are excited to announce that the datasets for AgiBot World Challenge 2026 have been updated.

	
		
	
	
		Track 1: Reasoning2Action
	

The Reasoning to Action track evaluates models' capabilities in reasoning and action prediction, comprising both online and onsite phases. This track encompasses 10 progressively challenging tasks, ranging from basic to complex, including dual-arm collaboration, long-horizon operations… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/agibot-world/AgiBotWorldChallenge-2026.
